Juno support

Have a question about Juno, or has something gone wrong? We’ll help you work it out and get back to learning.

Developer and contact

The developer of Juno: Англійська з книжками (English through books) and Juno: Англійські слова (Juno Star — English words) is Viacheslav Uspenskyi (“we”).

We are the controller of personal data for processing whose purposes and methods we determine for the operation of Juno, this website and user support.

For questions about the app, privacy or personal data processing, email:

support@junoreads.com

Frequently asked questions

About purchases, learning and your data.

How do I restore my Premium purchase?

Open the Premium screen in Juno and tap “Restore purchase” («Відновити покупку»). Use the same Apple Account in the App Store that you used to buy Premium.

If your active purchase cannot be found or an error occurs, email us. Do not send your account password or bank card details.

Is Premium a subscription?

No. Premium is a one-time in-app purchase. In Juno: English through books, it unlocks learning with all books, including new books added in updates. In Juno Star, it unlocks the full vocabulary. There are no automatic monthly or annual charges for this purchase.

Payments and purchase restoration are handled through Apple.

Where is my progress stored?

In the current version, learning progress, saved words, bookmarks and exercise state are stored on your device. Juno does not currently provide its own cloud synchronisation of progress.

Deleting the app together with its data removes local progress. Restoring a Premium purchase does not itself restore learning data.

What should I include in my message?

Describe the problem and the steps that lead to it. If possible, include your device model, iOS version, the name and version of your Juno app, and the book or exercise involved.

You can attach a screenshot after hiding any personal information. We do not need passwords, identity documents or full payment details.

How long is support correspondence kept?

We retain ordinary emails and attachments for as long as they are needed to handle your enquiry. Once the issue is finally resolved and the enquiry is closed, we delete them from our mailbox and delete copies we have saved.

We may retain specific information for longer only for a particular dispute or legal requirement. You can request deletion at any time. For details, see your app’s privacy policy: Juno Star — English words or Juno — English through books.
